bio: Located on the main square and run by the owner, La Alquería serves updated traditional cuisine of a high standard, including a surprise tasting menu option. In the kitchen, Clara Lapuente demonstrates a strong preference for locally sourced ingredients, and her previous experience as a pastry chef ensures that all dishes are cooked to perfection, including a delicious selection of desserts. The restaurant is located on the ground floor of a charming small hotel, so guests staying the night can take advantage of a special fixed-price dinner menu. Booking is essential....
